text.en:
1. (1) Peraturan-peraturan ini bolehlah dinamakan Peraturan-Peraturan
Keselamatan Sosial Pekerja (Gaji Bulanan Purata Minimum) 1999.

(2) Peraturan-Peraturan ini hendaklah disifatkan telah mula berkuat kuasa
pada 1 Januari 1999.

Pemakaian

2. Gaji bulanan purata minimum hendaklah terpakai kepada—
(a) sesuatu kes pencen ilat jika notis keilatannya telah diterima;
(b) sesuatu kes pencen penakat jika kematian berlaku; atau

(c) sesuatu kes pencen ilat atau pencen penakat yang sedang dibayar atau
jika tarikh terakrunya faedah itu jatuh,

2353                            P.U. (A) 354-355.

under the Loan Agreement for the purpose of a loan by the Lenders
to the Borrower of a principal amount of Japanese Yen Twenty Four
Billion (X24,000,000,000.00) only; and

(b) by the Government of Malaysia under a Guarantee whereby the
Government of Malaysia guarantees the repayment of the amount
referred to in subsubparagraph (a) by the Borrower to the Lenders and
the discharge of the other financial obligations of the Borrower
consequential or incidental to the repayment, for which provision is
made in the Loan Agreement.

Remission of stamp duty

3. Any stamp duty payable under the Stamp Act 1949 (Act 378] by the Borrower
in respect of the Loan Agreement shall be remitted.

Made 14 August 1999.
[S(59.03)248/24/1-7(SJ. 1); PN(PU?)232/IIT]

Dato' MustTAPA BIN MOHAMED
Second Minister of Finance
P.U. (A) 356.
